subject: phase3_controller_verification_handoff
statement: Accept the provider-free controller verification handoff and deterministic candidate-test separation implementation while keeping Phase 3 scored expansion unauthorized.
selected_option: retain the 12/16 boundary, permit only explicit tool-budget verification deferral through mandatory controller verification, and use production-with-supplemental-tests publication for new Phase 3 protocols

alternatives.option: raise the direct worker hard tool limit
alternatives.rejected_reason: A larger undifferentiated limit does not reserve a verification phase and would weaken the measured containment boundary.

alternatives.option: treat every failed worker patch as provisional
alternatives.rejected_reason: Failure may represent incomplete implementation, invalid scope, environment failure, permissions, or missing decisions; only the explicit narrow handoff is recoverable.

alternatives.option: remove candidate tests after an evaluator conflict
alternatives.rejected_reason: Post-hoc mutation would depend on evaluator outcomes and violate the frozen experiment contract.

rationale: The runtime now retains the worker's failed status while allowing a complete, scope-valid candidate with structured verification additions to enter existing isolated controller verification. It also derives complete, scored-production, and supplemental-test patches from one staged diff using only public deterministic path rules. Legacy contracts remain supported, all provider-free tests pass, artifact lint passes, and no model call occurred.
expected_outcome: A later separately authorized Phase 3 execution can retain complete candidate evidence, score only the frozen production patch, and finish verification through the controller when a worker's final tool budget is exhausted without silently accepting other worker failures.
acceptance_refs: complete provider-free unittest discovery: 1215 passed, 7 skipped
artifact lint: 203 JSON and 1 JSONL checked, zero errors
